Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Highbush and lowbush blueberries

Elders recalled berry picking on Shinnecock lands, at West Woods, and in the Pine Barrens. The catalogue describes berries dried for later use, used with meat, and added to samp with corn. Gathering and preservation extended the value of a short season.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock residential territories; West Woods; Pine Barrens; Shinnecock Hills.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF pp. 19–20. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
